note: This manifest classifies the current public callback surface. It is retained compatibility evidence, not the frozen 1.0 baseline.

runtime_storage_transaction.owner: Invoked synchronously by the single Runtime/Service owner while processing one outstanding Ready.
runtime_storage_transaction.borrow: The callback context is borrowed for the Runtime lifetime. Entry arrays and other pointer inputs are borrowed only for the callback duration.
runtime_storage_transaction.retain: Borrowed TurboRaft input pointers must not be retained. The storage backend may retain only its own copied transaction state until commit or rollback.
runtime_storage_transaction.reentry: Must not re-enter the same Runtime, Service, or Core while the callback is active.
runtime_storage_transaction.failure: A non-success storage step means the current durability sequence did not complete. Runtime does not advance Core or apply the FSM past an unproven durability boundary; rollback is best-effort and its error is reported separately.
runtime_storage_transaction.release: TurboRaft receives no owned resource from these callbacks; the backend owns and releases its context and transaction resources.

runtime_transport_admission.owner: Invoked synchronously by the Runtime/Service owner.
runtime_transport_admission.borrow: Message and snapshot request pointers are borrowed only for the callback duration.
runtime_transport_admission.retain: On SALTS_OK the transport must have made an independent local admission/copy sufficient for the caller to release the input. The input pointer itself must not be retained.
runtime_transport_admission.reentry: Must not re-enter the same Runtime, Service, or Core while admission is in progress.
runtime_transport_admission.failure: SALTS_OK means reliable local admission, not remote delivery. SALTS_ENOSPC is capacity backpressure where the Service contract permits retry/pause; other non-success values are fail-fast transport errors.
runtime_transport_admission.release: After SALTS_OK the transport owns its admitted copy/queue item and releases it according to the transport contract.

runtime_state_machine_apply.owner: Invoked synchronously by the Runtime/Service owner only after the corresponding storage durability sequence succeeds.
runtime_state_machine_apply.borrow: The committed entry array is borrowed only for the callback duration.
runtime_state_machine_apply.retain: The callback must not retain TurboRaft entry pointers; copy application data if later use is required.
runtime_state_machine_apply.reentry: Must not re-enter the same Runtime, Service, or Core while apply is active.
runtime_state_machine_apply.failure: Non-success faults the current Runtime/Service apply path and does not advance the public applied boundary.
runtime_state_machine_apply.release: No resource ownership is transferred to TurboRaft.

async_apply_state_machine.owner: Invoked synchronously by the single ApplyRuntime owner.
async_apply_state_machine.borrow: try_apply borrows the entry only for the call. poll_settlement writes into caller-owned output storage.
async_apply_state_machine.retain: ACCEPTED requires the state machine to own an independent copy. FULL transfers no ownership. TurboRaft does not retain callback-owned settlement storage.
async_apply_state_machine.reentry: Must not re-enter the same ApplyRuntime or its Core while either callback is active.
async_apply_state_machine.failure: FULL authorizes exact admission retry. PENDING settlement authorizes exact retry of the same token. Other settlements are terminal. Callback non-success outside these typed outcomes faults the ApplyRuntime.
async_apply_state_machine.release: The state machine releases any independently copied accepted entry and settlement resources on its side; no pointer returned by poll_settlement is retained by TurboRaft.

cflow_decode.owner: Invoked synchronously by the CFlow state-machine adapter on its owner thread.
cflow_decode.borrow: The Raft entry is borrowed only for the decoder call; out_event is caller-owned output storage.
cflow_decode.retain: Decoder scratch and the entry pointer must not be retained. CFlow copies the bounded event payload before admission returns.
cflow_decode.reentry: Must not re-enter the same CFlow adapter/ApplyRuntime while decoding.
cflow_decode.failure: Any non-success decode result rejects the entry and is propagated through the state-machine admission path.
cflow_decode.release: No resource ownership is transferred; variable-length commands must be represented by bounded self-contained event data.

control_audit_sink.owner: Invoked synchronously on the thread that emits the control audit event.
control_audit_sink.borrow: The audit event pointer is borrowed only for the sink call.
control_audit_sink.retain: The sink must copy the event if it needs data after return.
control_audit_sink.reentry: Must not recursively emit through the same audit object from the sink.
control_audit_sink.failure: For required audit sinks, non-success is propagated. For optional sinks, non-success is counted as a dropped audit event and the control path continues.

control_status_provider.owner: Invoked by the standalone CHttp/CRPC owner thread servicing the control request.
control_status_provider.borrow: The provider receives caller-owned output status storage and no retainable TurboRaft pointer.
control_status_provider.retain: The provider must not retain the output pointer. If Raft belongs to another owner, status must be copied through an executor/mailbox.
control_status_provider.reentry: Must not directly re-enter a single-owner Raft Service owned by another thread; recursive entry through the same ControlPlane request is unsupported.
control_status_provider.failure: Non-success makes the status request unavailable and is translated to the control-plane error response.

immutable_source.owner: read_at/release are invoked synchronously by the owning snapshot/data sender on its single owner thread.
immutable_source.borrow: read_at receives a borrowed bounded output buffer for the call. The source context remains owned by the transferred source descriptor until release.
immutable_source.retain: read_at must not retain the output buffer. A successfully transferred source may retain its own context until the matching release callback.
immutable_source.reentry: Must not re-enter the same sender/manager while read_at or release is active.
immutable_source.failure: A read_at non-success aborts/fails the current transfer according to the sender contract. release is terminal and cannot fail.
immutable_source.release: Source ownership transfers on successful source admission; release is invoked exactly once when that ownership ends.

stream_sink.owner: begin/write/commit/abort are invoked synchronously by the owning receiver on its single owner thread.
stream_sink.borrow: Configuration/digest/data pointers are borrowed only for each callback duration.
stream_sink.retain: The sink may copy/stage bytes into its own storage but must not retain TurboRaft input pointers.
stream_sink.reentry: Must not re-enter the same receiver while a sink callback is active.
stream_sink.failure: Non-success from begin/write/commit fails the receive operation. commit SALTS_OK is the visibility/completion boundary; abort discards any incomplete staging.
stream_sink.release: The sink owns and releases its internal staging resources; TurboRaft transfers no input pointer ownership.

service_snapshot_buffered.owner: Invoked synchronously by the single Service owner during automatic snapshot processing.
service_snapshot_buffered.borrow: create receives a borrowed output buffer; store receives borrowed configuration/data for the call.
service_snapshot_buffered.retain: The callbacks must not retain TurboRaft-provided buffers, configuration pointers, or data pointers.
service_snapshot_buffered.reentry: Must not re-enter the same Service/Core while snapshot callbacks are active.
service_snapshot_buffered.failure: store must make the snapshot durable before SALTS_OK. Non-success prevents Core compaction/ack past the snapshot boundary and follows Service fault handling.

service_snapshot_source.owner: Invoked synchronously by the single Service owner.
service_snapshot_source.borrow: source_store borrows the source descriptor and configuration only for the call.
service_snapshot_source.retain: source_create SALTS_OK transfers one owned immutable source to Service. source_store must not retain the source after return.
service_snapshot_source.reentry: Must not re-enter the same Service/Core while source_create/source_store is active.
service_snapshot_source.failure: source_store must make the snapshot durable before SALTS_OK. Failed creation transfers no usable source; failed store does not make the snapshot authoritative.
service_snapshot_source.release: Service invokes the source release callback exactly once after source_store returns, regardless of store success or failure.

service_journal_compact.owner: Invoked synchronously by the Service owner only after the corresponding snapshot is durable.
service_journal_compact.borrow: The callback context is borrowed by Service; index/term are values.
service_journal_compact.retain: No TurboRaft pointer is available to retain.
service_journal_compact.reentry: Must not re-enter the same Service/Core.
service_journal_compact.failure: SALTS_EIO keeps the exact snapshot index/term pending for retry. Any other non-success faults Service without compacting Core.

snapshot_manager_enqueue.owner: Invoked synchronously by the SnapshotManager owner while scheduling peer payloads.
snapshot_manager_enqueue.borrow: The payload pointer is borrowed only for the callback duration.
snapshot_manager_enqueue.retain: SALTS_OK requires independent local admission/copy; the payload pointer itself must not be retained.
snapshot_manager_enqueue.reentry: Must not re-enter the same SnapshotManager during enqueue.
snapshot_manager_enqueue.failure: SALTS_ENOSPC represents bounded transport backpressure; other non-success values fail the manager operation.
snapshot_manager_enqueue.release: After successful admission the transport owns and releases its queued copy.

snapshot_manager_buffered_provider.owner: Invoked synchronously by the SnapshotManager owner when a peer requires a snapshot.
snapshot_manager_buffered_provider.borrow: Output point/buffer storage is owned by the manager for the call.
snapshot_manager_buffered_provider.retain: The provider must not retain manager-owned output storage after return.
snapshot_manager_buffered_provider.reentry: Must not re-enter the same SnapshotManager.
snapshot_manager_buffered_provider.failure: Non-success means no buffered snapshot is admitted for the request.

snapshot_manager_source_provider.owner: Invoked synchronously by the SnapshotManager owner when a peer requires a database-scale snapshot.
snapshot_manager_source_provider.retain: SALTS_OK returns an owned immutable source descriptor. Ownership transfers into the peer sender only when the request is admitted.
snapshot_manager_source_provider.reentry: Must not re-enter the same SnapshotManager/sender during provider execution.
snapshot_manager_source_provider.failure: Non-success transfers no source ownership and the snapshot request is not admitted.
snapshot_manager_source_provider.release: Once admitted, the peer sender owns the source and eventually calls its release callback exactly once.

snapshot_manager_complete.owner: Invoked synchronously by the SnapshotManager owner after the remote peer acknowledges the complete snapshot.
snapshot_manager_complete.borrow: Only value arguments and borrowed context are supplied.
snapshot_manager_complete.retain: No TurboRaft pointer is available to retain.
snapshot_manager_complete.reentry: Must not re-enter the same SnapshotManager.
snapshot_manager_complete.failure: Non-success is propagated as completion failure; it does not revoke the already received remote acknowledgement.

snapshot_install.owner: Invoked synchronously by the SnapshotReceiver owner after a complete buffered snapshot passes validation.
snapshot_install.borrow: Configuration and snapshot data are borrowed only for the install call.
snapshot_install.retain: The callback must copy any data needed after return and must not retain TurboRaft input pointers.
snapshot_install.reentry: Must not re-enter the same SnapshotReceiver or owning Service during installation.
snapshot_install.failure: SALTS_OK is the installed/visible boundary for the buffered path. Non-success leaves the receive result uninstalled.

transport_payload_handler.owner: Invoked synchronously by tr_raft_transport_feed on the caller/TransportSession owner thread.
transport_payload_handler.borrow: Decoded payload values and nested views are borrowed only for the callback duration.
transport_payload_handler.retain: The handler must copy payload data needed after return.
transport_payload_handler.reentry: Must not re-enter the same TransportSession feed path while the callback is active.
transport_payload_handler.failure: The first non-success handler result is propagated from feed and the payload is not reported as successfully consumed.

text_executor_sink.owner: Invoked synchronously on the thread executing the parsed text plan.
text_executor_sink.borrow: Command/frame/status/member/progress views are borrowed only for the callback duration.
text_executor_sink.retain: Callbacks must copy any view needed after return.
text_executor_sink.reentry: Recursive execution of the same executor/service operation is unsupported; Service-backed query callbacks must respect the single-owner Service rule.
text_executor_sink.failure: The first non-success callback result is returned unchanged and stops plan execution.

replay_driver.owner: Invoked synchronously by the single replay driver execution thread.
replay_driver.borrow: Committed entry arrays and output tick storage are borrowed for the callback duration.
replay_driver.retain: The apply callback must copy entries needed later; the timeout callback must not retain out_ticks.
replay_driver.reentry: Must not re-enter the same replay driver.
replay_driver.failure: A non-success timeout/apply callback aborts the current replay action/run and is propagated.

replay_executor.owner: Invoked synchronously in replay plan order on the caller thread.
replay_executor.borrow: Action/payload/receipt views are borrowed only for the callback duration.
replay_executor.retain: Callbacks must copy borrowed action/payload/receipt data needed later.
replay_executor.reentry: Recursive execution of the same replay executor is unsupported.
replay_executor.failure: The first callback failure is returned unchanged and stops execution; unknown request ids and duplicate ids use the documented deterministic errors.
replay_executor.release: Receipts are executor-owned values; no pointer/resource ownership is transferred.
